title: Population differences in Mendelian disease phenotypes: analysis code, case tables and 66,198 GA4GH phenopackets
description:
Code and data for a case-to-case analysis of population differences in the recorded phenotypes of patients with Mendelian disease. 66,198 patients from the GA4GH Phenopacket Store (v0.1.26), PMC-Patients, PubMed case-report abstracts and the PAVS database are provided as GA4GH Phenopacket v2 files with patient origin, ancestry, place of care, reporting group and curation corpus as subject extensions. The archive also contains the analysis code, the job scripts, per-case tables, all test outputs with Benjamini-Hochberg q-values, and the figures.

Code: BSD 3-Clause. Data: CC BY 4.0; records derived from PMC-Patients are additionally subject to the PMC-Patients licence (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0).
